answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 100 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in haven, queued in prism, and onyx publishes the wait time. A farm of 135 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4592 identities would post 1653 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
